Summary: The SMS code still works after 10 minutes, it should expire.
Description:
UAT note 1: The SMS code still works after 10 minutes, it should expire.
Baseline: REQ-01
Why: REQ-01 says the SMS one-time code expires after 5 minutes, but the code still works after 10 minutes, so the system does not meet the requirement.

Summary: On the search screen the label says "Speciality", please change it to "Specialty".
Description:
UAT note 3: On the search screen the label says "Speciality", please change it to "Specialty".
Baseline: REQ-02
Why: REQ-02 requires search by specialty, and correcting the label spelling from "Speciality" to "Specialty" is a small wording change within that requirement's intent.

Summary: I booked a 4th appointment and the system allowed it.
Description:
UAT note 4: I booked a 4th appointment and the system allowed it.
Baseline: REQ-04
Why: REQ-04 limits a patient to at most 3 future bookings at the same time, yet the system accepted a 4th booking, so it does not meet the requirement.

Summary: In My bookings the list is sorted oldest first.
Description:
UAT note 5: In My bookings the list is sorted oldest first.
Baseline: REQ-05
Why: REQ-05 requires future bookings sorted by date with the nearest first, but the note reports the list is sorted oldest first, which does not match the requirement.

Summary: Reminder SMS did not arrive for tomorrow's appointment.
Description:
UAT note 8: Reminder SMS did not arrive for tomorrow's appointment.
Baseline: REQ-07
Why: REQ-07 requires a reminder SMS 24 hours before the appointment, and the tester reports none arrived for tomorrow's appointment; confirm the appointment is now within 24 hours when reproducing.

Summary: The English version of the booking confirmation has an Arabic sentence at the bottom.
Description:
UAT note 11: The English version of the booking confirmation has an Arabic sentence at the bottom.
Baseline: REQ-11
Why: REQ-11 requires all patient screens to be available in English, so an untranslated Arabic sentence on the English booking confirmation means the system does not meet the requirement.
